# Hardware PIT fixtures

Binary partition tables captured from real phones in Download Mode. Used by `test_planner` and referenced in [hardware.md](../../docs/hardware.md).

| File | Device | Notes |
|------|--------|--------|
| `SM-N920I.pit` | Galaxy Note 5 (SM-N920I) | 8192 bytes, UFS, 22 entries; read 2026-11-08 |

When you record a new PIT backup, add it here and a short row in this table. Do not commit customer data paths or unique serials.
